name: Vesper
_about: A small, cute take on Vesper (Concept/vesper-star-script-witch/) for sprite sheets: the navy hat with its gold crescent, the purple bob, a short plum cape with gold trim and a star, in simple clean lines. About three and three-quarter heads tall: cute, but with enough body to act. Hands empty, so the cast drags no prop.
